header: WHEN THE PEOPLE NAME SEARCH IS WORTH RUNNING (step 61a; ledger item 32). On every Enter the box also fired GET /api/employees/search?mode=name&q=<the whole text>, a fuzzy and phonetic search of NAMES. For a sentence ("list the employees of chrd", "how many people work in learning and development") it can only burn 1 to 7 seconds of database time and return nothing useful: the question is answered by the other routes. I want the name search only for what can BE a name: one to four words ("kumar", "sanjay debnath", "mohd anwar ullah", "soumit c&it", "c&it roy"), not a question and not a command. Pure (no server code): the query modal calls it before it starts the name search.

symbols.name: OPENS_A_SENTENCE
doc: The first word of a question or a command: I never treat such a text as a name.

symbols.name: TOPIC_WORDS
doc: A word that names a TOPIC (people in general, a list, a holiday, a degree ...): I treat a short text that holds one ("super speciality doctors", "holiday list 2024") as a topic, not a name.

behaviours: a name or a name and a department: "${q}" runs the name search
a sentence: "${q.slice(0, 54)}" does NOT run the name search
PAX: a question about the directory of land-line numbers is a topic, not a name ("pax fire service", "civil pax", "extension of c&it")
...and a bare department word stays searchable as a name ("fire service", "civil"): the PAX route does not take it
a question mark is never a name
five words are too many for a name (four are the limit)
'Name' as the first word of a sentence is a command, 'name' inside is not ('kumar name')
a name that merely STARTS like a command word ('Listan', 'Whosan') is still a name
OmnibarModal starts the name search only when looksLikeNameSearch(query) is true
...and the other searches of the Enter key are untouched (triggerSearch("semantic") still runs for every question)
